name: Captain's Armband
effect: After this unit's Ultimate triggers, remove all debuffs from unit and allies.
eligible: Bokuto, Daichi, Daisho, Futakuchi, Kiryu, Kita, Kuroo, Oikawa, Takeru, Ushijima

name: Flashy New Shoes
effect: If foe initiates combat and team's HP ≥ 75%, if unit can counterattack, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

name: Energy Drink
effect: At the start of turn 1, reduces unit's current Ultimate cooldown count by 1.

name: Rock Solid Game Plan
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Atk-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Rec < unit's Rec through their next actions.
eligible: Akaashi, Atsumu, Kageyama, Kenma, Koganegawa, Oikawa, Shirabu, Suga, Usuri

name: All Out Game Plan
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Def-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Rec < unit's Rec through their next actions.
eligible: Akaashi, Atsumu, Kageyama, Kenma, Koganegawa, Oikawa, Shirabu, Suga, Usuri

name: Tricky Game Plan
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Rec-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Rec < unit's Rec through their next actions.
eligible: Akaashi, Atsumu, Kageyama, Kenma, Koganegawa, Oikawa, Shirabu, Suga, Usuri

name: Tiring Game Plan
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Spd-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Rec < unit's Rec through their next actions.
eligible: Akaashi, Atsumu, Kageyama, Kenma, Koganegawa, Oikawa, Shirabu, Suga, Usuri

name: Wicked Game Plan
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Jmp-3 on foes in cardinal directions with Rec < unit's Rec through their next actions.
eligible: Akaashi, Atsumu, Kageyama, Kenma, Koganegawa, Oikawa, Shirabu, Suga, Usuri

name: Recruit's Compression Sleeve
effect: If unit is not allied with any units from the same School, grants Pow/Qik+4 during combat.

name: Recruit's Finger Tape
effect: If unit is not allied with any units from the same School, grants Def/Rec+3 during combat.

name: Recruit's Shoes
effect: If unit is not allied with any units from the same School, grants Spd+4 during combat.

name: Recruit's Knee Pads
effect: If unit is not allied with any units from the same School, grants Jmp+4 during combat.

name: Protein Packed Meal
effect: Grants Pow/Qik+1.

name: Carb Loaded Meal
effect: Grants Def+2.

name: Electrolyte Rich Meal
effect: Grants Rec+2.

name: Light & Lean Meal
effect: Grants Spd+1.

name: High Energy Meal
effect: Grants Jmp+1.

name: Freezing Stare
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Spd-5 on foe on the enemy team with the highest Spd through its next action.

name: Death Stare
effect: At start of turn, inflicts Jmp-5 on the foe with the highest Jmp through its next action.

name: Athletic Tape
effect: If foe initiates combat and unit and foe are in the front-line, grants Def/Rec+4 during combat.
eligible: Aone, Hinata - Miracle Maker, Hinata - Wings of Dawn, Hirugami, Kuroo, Lev, Suna, Tendo, Tsuki, Unnan, Washio

name: Padded Arm Sleeves
effect: If foe initiates combat and unit and foe are in the back-line, grants Def/Rec+4 during combat.
eligible: Akagi, Kanbayashi, Komi, Kosuke, Nishinoya, Yaku, Yamagata

name: Onset of Desperation
effect: At start of turn, if team's HP ≤ 50%, grants Spd+7 for 1 turn.

name: Ten Thousand Reps
effect: If unit receives consecutive attacks and foe is not the same position as unit, reduces damage from foe's second attack onward by 30%.

name: Heavy Hands
effect: If unit's Pow/Qik ≥ foe's Pow/Qik+5, grants Ultimate cooldown charge+1 whenever unit attacks. Does not stack.

name: Rigorous Film Study
effect: Neutralizes effects that guarantee unit's and foe's follow-up attacks.

name: Manager's Good Luck Charm
effect: Restores 10 HP to team after combat.

name: Pre-Game Meditation
effect: Grants Def/Rec+6. Inflicts Pow/Qik-3.

name: Burden of Expectation
effect: Grants Pow/Qik/Spd+5. Inflicts Def/Rec-5.

name: Worthless Pride
effect: Grants Pow/Qik/Def/Rec/Spd/Jmp+3. After combat, deals 15 damage to unit.

name: Vigilance
effect: If team's HP ≥75% at combat start, inflicts Ultimate cooldown charge−1 on foe whenever foe attacks or is attacked during that combat. Does not stack.

name: Synchronized Attack
effect: If unit is allied with an ally from the same School as unit, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Rec
eligible: Aone, Hinata - Miracle Maker, Hinata - Wings of Dawn, Hirugami, Kuroo, Lev, Suna, Tendo, Tsuki, Unnan, Washio

name: Smelling Salts
effect: If a skill compares unit's Spd to a foe's or ally's Spd, treats unit's Spd as if granted +7.

name: Water Bottle
effect: At start of even-numbered turns, restores 20 HP.

name: Own Tempo
effect: Neutralizes effects that grant "Ultimate cooldown charge +X" to foe or inflict "Ultimate cooldown charge -X" on unit during combat.

name: Matchbreaker
effect: If a match would end in a tie, you win. If the opponent has this equipped on a unit, you tie instead.

name: Second Wind
effect: After combat, if unit’s remaining Ultimate cooldown count equals its maximum, reduces it by 1.

name: Loaded Approach
effect: If unit initiates combat, grants Pow/Qik during combat equal to unit’s maximum Ultimate cooldown count +2.

name: Loaded Reception
effect: If foe initiates combat, grants Pow/Qik during combat equal to unit’s maximum Ultimate cooldown count +2.

name: Weighted Wristbands
effect: Increases maximum Ultimate cooldown count by 1. If foe initiates combat, grants Ultimate cooldown charge+1 whenever unit attacks or is attacked. Does not stack.

name: Alternating Drills
effect: At start of odd-numbered turns, grants Rec+6 to unit and allies in the same line for that turn. At start of even-numbered turns, grants Def+6 instead.

name: Last Rally
effect: If unit initiates combat against a foe that can counterattack and team’s HP ≤50% at combat start, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

name: Pressure Board
effect: At start of turn, converts visible stat bonuses on foes in cardinal directions with maximum HP ≤ unit’s maximum HP into visible penalties through their next actions.

name: Block Breaker
effect: Effective against MB foes: multiplies damage dealt to MB foes by 1.2.

name: Reading Glasses
effect: At combat start, if unit’s Spd ≥ foe’s Spd−7, inflicts Pow/Qik/Def penalties during combat equal to 50% of unit’s Rec minus foe’s Rec before combat (rounded down; minimum 0, maximum 7).

name: Specialist Badge
effect: If no other ally shares unit’s volleyball position, grants Pow/Qik+6 during combat.

name: Disruptive Whistle
effect: After combat, inflicts Pow/Qik−5 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions.

name: Fresh Legs
effect: At combat start, if unit’s team HP ≥ foe’s team HP+12, grants Pow/Qik+5 during combat.

name: Fresh Guard
effect: At combat start, if unit’s team HP ≥ foe’s team HP+12, grants Def+6 during combat.

name: Fresh Focus
effect: At combat start, if unit’s team HP ≥ foe’s team HP+12, grants Rec+6 during combat.

name: Recovery Snack
effect: If unit initiates combat, restores 12 HP to team after combat.

name: Seam Finder
effect: Inflicts Def/Rec−3 on foe and neutralizes foe’s visible Def/Rec bonuses during combat.

name: Pace Disruptor
effect: If foe’s Spd ≥ unit’s Spd, inflicts Pow/Qik−4 on foe during combat.

name: Rally Momentum
effect: If unit initiates combat, grants Pow/Qik during combat equal to 2 + twice the number of other allies that have already acted this turn (maximum 6).

name: Rally Footwork
effect: If unit initiates combat, grants Spd during combat equal to 2 + twice the number of other allies that have already acted this turn (maximum 6).

name: Rally Elevation
effect: If unit initiates combat, grants Jmp during combat equal to 1 + twice the number of other allies that have already acted this turn (maximum 5).

name: Recovery Denial
effect: If unit initiates combat, reduces the foe team’s in-combat HP restoration by 50% and prevents that team from restoring HP after that combat.

name: Firm Contact
effect: Deals +3 damage per hit during combat.

name: Bonus Scrutiny
effect: Inflicts Pow/Qik/Spd/Jmp penalties on foe during combat equal to the number of distinct [Bonus] effects active on foe (maximum 5).

name: Open Guard
effect: Grants Def/Rec+7. Foes initiating combat against unit make a guaranteed follow-up attack.

name: Ultimate Impact
effect: When unit’s damaging Ultimate triggers from unit’s attack, adds damage equal to unit’s maximum Ultimate cooldown count ×4 for that hit.
